subject: Encord & [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

[COMPANY]'s came up during a chat with 1X at our Physical AI event in SF last
week, and I wanted to reach out directly to see if you'd be open for a
quick chat?

We're working with a bunch of your assembly automation peers (1X, Figure
AI, Pickle Robot, Physical Intelligence) to help fine-tune their VLMs -
mainly using agentic workflows to automate annotation pipelines as things
scale.

Bit of context on Encord…we're a computer vision scale-up (Series B, $50M
raised) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation, and model
evaluation in one platform.

Would you be the right person for a brief discussion? We'd value the
opportunity to introduce ourselves and hear your perspective. Our
leadership team is available next Thursday or Friday afternoon (PT), but
can flex if need be.

Vannevar's name came up during a chat with Controp at our Physical AI event
in SF last week, so I wanted to reach out directly to see if you'd be open
for a quick chat?

evaluation in one platform.

opportunity to introduce ourselves and hear your perspective. Our
leadership team is available next Thursday or Friday afternoon (PT), but
can flex if need be.
